title: PAX / FORSAND wardrobe combination
description: PAX / FORSAND wardrobe combination, white/white, 291/2x235/8x931/8" This is a tiny wardrobe with smart solutions. A divider gives you space for long garments on the side, maximizing the space left with trays and drawers.
features: Different wall materials require different types of fasteners. Use fasteners suitable for the walls in your home.
Two people are needed to assemble this furniture.
The frame can be assembled in an upright position if your ceiling height is a minimum of 93¼". Follow the assembly instructions in the package.
Interior accessories that help you organize inside your wardrobe are sold separately.
Knobs and handles are sold separately.
Hinges are needed for this product. They are included in the price but are picked up separately.
The clothes rail holds about 30 shirts on hangers.
